oracle-l5r-241: Akodo Makotai (Tactical Limited: Create a 2F Follower and attach it to Makotai). The engine side exists (Creates: new(CardType.Follower, Force: 2, ProxyId: "oracle-l5r-9738") { HostIsSource = true } on a Limited ability with ActionKeywords ["Tactical"], the Tactician performer/once-per-turn Tactical rule already reads the keyword), but the created card must be the plain 2F Follower Proxy, the Emperor Edition 'Infantry Follower' (oracle-l5r-9738, printing 4, #11: Force 2, no keywords, no text). No published created-only Follower fits: the only 2F one is the Ronin Follower (oracle-l5r-10203), whose Ronin keyword would be a wrong extra keyword on a plain 'Follower', and the Infantry Follower is not published. Publishing it needs a created-only follower wave (follower-wave-24's shape: Type Follower, CreatedOnly true, Effect none) built from its scan, but the scan is not among the local assets (only its receipt JSON exists under assets/reference/oracle/emperor-edition/receipts; the jpg/webp was never downloaded). Once that scan is fetched (source_url in the receipt) and packaged, wiring Makotai is one catalogue entry plus the Creates spec and a case in RunEmperorPersonalityBatch2Effect (CreatedCardEntry already attaches to command.CardId for HostIsSource).
